descriptions.zh: 该API主要用于进行自动化服务台上资源编排任务和资源栈任务状态文件的偏差检测。
descriptions.en: This API is used to perform drift detection on the state files of resource orchestration tasks and stack tasks in the automated service desk.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iacservice detect-terraform-state --client-token a65451293e64979ba7a4b573950217fe --type Stack --identifier stack-as11xxxxxxxxx:developmentA --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
